connect.title: Connect Server
connect.desc: Connect your phone to the AI gateway
connect.tailscaleDesc: Tailscale creates a secure private network across all your devices — no public IP or port forwarding needed.
connect.tailscalePrivacyNote: Tailscale establishes end-to-end encrypted tunnels. Tailscale's servers cannot read your traffic.
connect.deployNewServerDesc: One-click OpenClaw install on a VPS via SSH
connect.guideStep1: Install and start Tailscale on your server (the machine running openclaw)
connect.guideStep2: Install the Tailscale app on your phone and sign in to the same account
connect.guideStep3: Check your server's Tailscale IP (100.x.x.x) in the desktop ClawNo.11 Connectors page
connect.guideStep4: Enter the IP in the URL field below, e.g. http://100.x.x.x:18789
connect.xedgeDesc: xEdge is a Tailscale-compatible mesh networking tool. Log in with WeChat — no public server needed. Relay nodes ensure low latency. Free tier: 20 devices, 1 GB/month.
connect.xedgeStep1: Install the xEdge client on your desktop PC (the machine running ClawNo.11) and scan the QR code with WeChat to log in
connect.xedgeStep2: Install the xEdge client on this phone (iOS / Android) and scan with the same WeChat account
connect.xedgeStep3: Your phone and PC are now on the same private network; the PC gets a 100.x.x.x IP
connect.xedgeStep4: This page auto-detects the 100.x.x.x IP (xEdge is Tailscale-compatible) and fills the URL field below
connect.xedgeTip: xEdge uses the Tailscale protocol — once connected, the IP is detected and filled automatically
connect.urlHint: Open the desktop app → Connectors page to see available addresses. Copy one and paste it here. Port 18800 is the Chat Proxy.
connect.testFailed: Connection failed. Check the URL and network.
